reason: I already run Square on an iPad and it works. Paying $49 a month plus $299 for a reader, to move my cards and my records to a new company I have never heard of, is a big risk for a small salon like mine.
objection: Card fees are where the real money is. You say it is Stripe's 2.7% + 5 cents with no markup, but is that really cheaper than what I pay now with Square? Show me on my own statement. And who are you, will you still be around next year?
would_change_my_mind: A side-by-side of my last 3 months of card fees on Square versus your rate, plus names of 2 or 3 Vietnamese salons near me already using it and happy.
